summary: Delete an orphan record at the provider again

parameters.name: recordID
parameters.description: ID of the dynamic DNS record of a host name, as the list shows it

200.description: The name state after: `off` once deleted, else `orphan` with the new error

400.description: The record is not an orphan (`error.ddns-not-orphan`)

403.description: The user lacks a needed right

404.description: The record or its host does not exist or the user may not see it

description:
A record NPMpro made for a host stayed at the provider because its delete failed (an orphan). This tries the delete again for each address left; on success the row is removed. When the provider now holds another value than the one NPMpro wrote, that record is left there and the row stays an orphan with a note.

Needs: Certificates manage, the credential visible
